payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate k from 1 to n, memoize by gcd(k,n). For each new gcd g, check parity of bit sums in each residue class mod g; if all even, k is valid.
payload.rationale: Solution does a complete search over k with gcd grouping to avoid redundant checks. No advanced search technique; loosely fits as brute-force with early termination.
